scripts.audit:ci: npm run audit:ci:api && npm run audit:ci:ui && npm run audit:ci:koa-api && npm run audit:ci:react-ui && npm run audit:ci:hono-api && npm run audit:ci:svelte-ui && npm run audit:ci:vue-ui && npm run audit:ci:nuxt-api
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:ui
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:ui
scripts.build:koa: npm run build:koa-api && npm run build:react-ui
scripts.build:nuxt: npm run build:nuxt-api && npm run build:vue-ui
scripts.build:svelte: npm run build:svelte-ui && npm run build:hono-api
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:koa && npm run build:vue && npm run build:svelte && npm run build:nuxt
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:ui
scripts.ci:api: cd api && npm ci && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.ci:koa: npm run ci:koa-api && npm run ci:react-ui
scripts.ci:nuxt: npm run ci:nuxt-api && npm run ci:vue-ui
scripts.ci:svelte: npm run ci:svelte-ui && npm run ci:hono-api
scripts.ci:all: npm ci && npm run ci:api && npm run ci:ui && npm run ci:koa && npm run ci:vue && npm run ci:svelte && npm run ci:nuxt
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui && npm run test:react-ui && npm run test:svelte-ui && npm run test:vue-ui
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:api -- --coverage && npm run test:ui -- --coverage
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:vue && npm run test:e2e:svelte && npm run test:e2e:react-koa
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules api/node_modules ui/node_modules api/dist ui/.next
scripts.docs:types:nuxt: npx -y ts-to-mermaid nuxt-api/shared/types.ts --save docs/types/nuxt-api/ && echo >> docs/types/nuxt-api/types.mermaid
scripts.docs:types:ui: npx -y ts-to-mermaid ui/src/types/application.ts --save docs/types/ui/ && echo >> docs/types/ui/application.mermaid
scripts.docs:types:react-ui: npx -y ts-to-mermaid react-ui/src/types/application.ts --save docs/types/react-ui/ && echo >> docs/types/react-ui/application.mermaid
scripts.docs:types:koa-api: npx -y ts-to-mermaid koa-api/src/types/index.ts --save docs/types/koa-api/ && echo >> docs/types/koa-api/index.mermaid
scripts.docs:types:svelte-ui: npx -y ts-to-mermaid svelte-ui/src/lib/types/index.ts --save docs/types/svelte-ui/ && echo >> docs/types/svelte-ui/index.mermaid
scripts.docs:types: npm run docs:types:nuxt && npm run docs:types:ui && npm run docs:types:react-ui && npm run docs:types:koa-api && npm run docs:types:svelte-ui
